overall: The AG found the Needham Select Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by meeting in executive session on May 9 under Purpose 6, and declined to review earlier sessions not raised in the original complaint.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the May 9 executive session under Purpose 6 was improper because the Town had no negotiating position, since Northland had not yet bought the property.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board did have a negotiating position to protect when it met in executive session on May 9.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged it was improper for the Board to discuss the 40B housing project in executive session, citing a prior determination about a different 40B project.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Board met in executive session on May 9 for a proper purpose.

allegations.summary: On further review, complainant raised concerns about executive sessions on the Foster Property held over the prior year, which were not in the original complaint filed with the Board.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review these allegations as they were not first raised in a complaint filed with the Board; we offer no opinion regarding the propriety of any executive session meetings other than the one held on May 9.
